Websites, dashboards, apps and workshops built for research teams and communities. Each project links to the live site and, when the code is public, to its repository.

::: {.areas}

::: {}
### Teaching

Workshops on programming in R, building R packages, web development, statistical modelling, bioinformatics, network and time-series analysis, and data visualization.
:::

::: {}
### Research

Projects led or co-led with researchers studying social insects, the natural history of birds, and brain and cognitive development in newborns and adolescents.
:::

::: {}
### Consulting

Problems solved from design to implementation, from a complete web presence to turning static spreadsheets into interactive websites.
:::

## Open-source tools

Public code that isn't tied to a website, most recently updated first. This list is refreshed from GitHub every day.

```{r}
#| label: repo-table
# Public, non-fork, non-archived repos from both GitHub accounts, fetched on every
# render (CI renders daily). Repos already shown as projects are left out.
# If the API call fails, the last saved copy in assets/data/repos.json is used.
owners <- c("beepboopstats", "biplabendu")
exclude <- c(
  owners, "babyshower", "my_dummy_website", # profile and personal repos
  "beepboopstats.github.io", "gha-workflows", "manuscripts" # this site, build config, papers
)
snapshot <- "assets/data/repos.json"
fields <- c("name", "html_url", "description", "language", "pushed_at", "fork", "archived")

fetch_repos <- function(owner) {
  token <- Sys.getenv("GITHUB_PAT", Sys.getenv("GITHUB_TOKEN"))
  headers <- c(Accept = "application/vnd.github+json")
  if (nzchar(token)) headers <- c(headers, Authorization = paste("Bearer", token))
  con <- url(
    sprintf("https://api.github.com/users/%s/repos?per_page=100&type=owner", owner),
    headers = headers
  )
  on.exit(close(con))
  jsonlite::fromJSON(paste(readLines(con, warn = FALSE), collapse = ""))[, fields]
}

repos <- tryCatch(
  {
    r <- do.call(rbind, lapply(owners, fetch_repos))
    # write-then-rename so a concurrent render (e.g. quarto preview) never reads a half-written file
    tmp <- tempfile(tmpdir = dirname(snapshot), fileext = ".json")
    jsonlite::write_json(r, tmp, pretty = TRUE)
    file.rename(tmp, snapshot)
    r
  },
  error = function(e) {
    message("GitHub API failed (", conditionMessage(e), "); using ", snapshot)
    jsonlite::read_json(snapshot, simplifyVector = TRUE)
  }
)

project_repos <- basename(unlist(lapply(yaml::read_yaml("projects.yml"), `[[`, "code")))
keep <- !repos$fork & !repos$archived & !repos$name %in% c(exclude, project_repos)
tools <- repos[keep, ]
tools <- tools[order(tools$pushed_at, decreasing = TRUE), ]

# Repos without a GitHub description get a generic one based on their language
missing <- is.na(tools$description) | !nzchar(trimws(tools$description))
tools$description[missing] <- ifelse(
  is.na(tools$language[missing]),
  "Code repository on GitHub.",
  paste0("Code repository on GitHub, written mainly in ", tools$language[missing], ".")
)

htmltools::tags$table(
  class = "table repo-table",
  htmltools::tags$thead(htmltools::tags$tr(
    lapply(c("Repository", "Description", "Language", "Updated"), htmltools::tags$th)
  )),
  htmltools::tags$tbody(lapply(seq_len(nrow(tools)), function(i) {
    repo <- tools[i, ]
    htmltools::tags$tr(
      htmltools::tags$td(htmltools::tags$a(href = repo$html_url, repo$name)),
      htmltools::tags$td(trimws(repo$description)),
      htmltools::tags$td(if (is.na(repo$language)) "" else repo$language),
      htmltools::tags$td(format(as.Date(substr(repo$pushed_at, 1, 10)), "%b %Y"))
    )
  }))
)
```
